 function step(dt,now){const G=H.G;if(!G)return;

 function walkPts(P, s, V) { let d = s * V; for (let i = 1; i < P.length; i++) { const a = P[i - 1], b = P[i], L = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]); if (d <= L) { const f = d / L; return [lerp(a[0], b[0], f), lerp(a[1], b[1], f), Math.atan2(b[1] - a[1], b[0] - a[0]), false]; } d -= L; } const z = P[P.length - 1], y = P[P.length - 2] || z; return [z[0], z[1], Math.atan2(z[1] - y[1], z[0] - y[0] + 1e-6), true]; }
 function showDunk(ctx, Q, s, u, res) { let fly = null;

  return fly; }

  const order = { pax: ['aurelia', 'sunbeak', 'zebrano', 'coral', 'tidewind', 'mirage', 'confetti', 'skyline'], cargo: ['crateway', 'boxline', 'swiftpak', 'pelicarga'] };
  for (const g in order) { const A = order[g], arr = L[g]; for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) { const id = A[i % A.length], v = Math.floor(i / A.length) % 2, x = V[id] && V[id][v]; if (!x) continue;
   const lv = arr[i], rf = q(x[0], x[1], x.slice(2)); lv.rf0 = lv.rf0 || { b: lv.b, u: lv.u, s: lv.s, t: lv.t, m: lv.m, eng: lv.eng };
   Object.assign(lv, { b: rf.b, u: rf.u, s: rf.s, t: rf.t, m: rf.m, eng: rf.eng, rf, rfId: id + ':' + v }); S.n++; S.ids.push(id + ':' + v); } }
  return true; }
 function col(rf, u, co) { return field(rf, u, Math.acos(clamp(co, -1, 1)) / TAU); }
 
 function tex(rf) { let t = TX.get(rf); if (t) return t; const W = 192, H = 24; t = document.createElement('canvas'); t.width = W; t.height = H; const g = t.getContext('2d'), im = g.createImageData(W, H), d = im.data, C = new Map();
  const rgb = h => { let r = C.get(h); if (!r) { r = [parseInt(h.slice(1, 3), 16), parseInt(h.slice(3, 5), 16), parseInt(h.slice(5, 7), 16)]; C.set(h, r); } return r; };
  for (let j = 0; j < H; j++) { const y = (j + .5) / H * 2 - 1, v = Math.asin(y) / TAU; for (let i = 0; i < W; i++) { const r = rgb(field(rf, (i + .5) / W, v)), k = (j * W + i) * 4; d[k] = r[0]; d[k + 1] = r[1]; d[k + 2] = r[2]; d[k + 3] = 255; } }
  g.putImageData(im, 0, 0); TX.set(rf, t); S.tex++; return t; }
 function wrapRf(c, L, hw, nl, tl, lv) { if (!S.on || !lv || !lv.rf) return false; try { const t = tex(lv.rf); c.save(); c.scale(-1, 1); c.imageSmoothingEnabled = true; c.drawImage(t, -L / 2, -hw, L, hw * 2); c.restore();
   const g = c.createLinearGradient(0, -hw, 0, hw); g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,.16)'); g.addColorStop(.3, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); g.addColorStop(.7, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,.2)'); c.fillStyle = g; c.fillRect(-L / 2, -hw, L, hw * 2); S.wrap++; return true; }
  catch (e) { S.err = S.err || String(e && e.message || e); return false; } }
 
 function fns(t, lv, tailAt) { const rf = lv.rf, L = t.L, M = new Map(); S.fns++;
  const c3 = (a, th) => col(rf, a / L, Math.sin(th));
  const breaks = th => { let B = M.get(th); if (B) return B; B = []; const n = 160; let p = c3(0, th);
   for (let k = 1; k <= n; k++) { const a = k / n * L, c = c3(a, th); if (c !== p) { let lo = (k - 1) / n * L, hi = a; for (let m = 0; m < 6; m++) { const md = (lo + hi) / 2; if (c3(md, th) === p) lo = md; else hi = md; } B.push((lo + hi) / 2); p = c; } }
   M.set(th, B); return B; };
  return { col: c3, breaks, tailAt }; }
 try { apply(); } catch (e) { S.err = String(e); }
 window.TC_LIV3 = { wrap: (c, L, hw, nl, tl, lv) => wrapRf(c, L, hw, nl, tl, lv) };   
 function audit() { const bad = []; for (const id in V) for (let v = 0; v < 2; v++) { const x = V[id][v]; if (!x) { bad.push(id + ':' + v); continue; } const rf = q(x[0], x[1], x.slice(2)), set = new Set();
   for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) for (let j = 0; j < 9; j++) set.add(col(rf, i / 39, Math.cos(j / 8 * PI))); if (set.size < 2) bad.push(id + ':' + v + ':flat'); }
  return { ok: !bad.length && !S.err && S.n === 24, n: S.n, bad, err: S.err, zebrano: V.zebrano.map(x => x[0]) }; }
 return { S, V, field, wrap: wrapRf, fns, audit, apply, get on() { return S.on; }, set on(b) { S.on = !!b; } };
})();

 };
 const TX = new Map(), ST = { n: 0, html: 0, paint: 0, blit: 0, err: null };
 function has(id) { return !!(id && M[id]); }
 function draw(c, id, x, y, s) { const f = M[id]; if (!f) return false; c.save(); try { f(c, x, y, s, {}); } catch (e) { ST.err = ST.err || String(e && e.message || e); } c.restore(); ST.n++; return true; }
 function tex(id) { let t = TX.get(id); if (!t) { t = document.createElement('canvas'); t.width = t.height = 64; draw(t.getContext('2d'), id, 0, 0, 64); TX.set(id, t); } return t; }
 function blit(c, id, x, y, s) { if (!M[id]) return false; c.drawImage(tex(id), x, y, s, s); ST.blit++; return true; }
 function html(id, s, label) { ST.html++; const r = Math.max(2, Math.ceil(window.devicePixelRatio || 1)); return `<canvas data-tcsp="${id}" width="${s * r}" height="${s * r}" style="width:${s}px;height:${s}px;vertical-align:-3px;flex:none" aria-label="${label || ''}" role="img"></canvas>`; }
 function paint(cv) { const id = cv.dataset.tcsp; cv.dataset.tcspDone = '1'; const g = cv.getContext('2d'); if (!g) return; g.clearRect(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height); draw(g, id, 0, 0, Math.min(cv.width, cv.height)); ST.paint++; }
 function scan(root) { const L = root && root.getElementsByTagName ? root.getElementsByTagName('canvas') : []; for (let i = 0; i < L.length; i++) { const cv = L[i]; if (cv.dataset.tcsp && !cv.dataset.tcspDone) paint(cv); } }
 try { new MutationObserver(R => { for (const m of R) for (const n of m.addedNodes) { if (n.nodeType !== 1) continue; if (n.tagName === 'CANVAS') { if (n.dataset.tcsp && !n.dataset.tcspDone) paint(n); } else if (n.firstElementChild) scan(n); } })
  .observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true }); } catch (e) { ST.err = String(e); }
 function audit() { const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = c.height = 32; const g = c.getContext('2d'), bad = [];
  for (const id in M) { g.clearRect(0, 0, 32, 32); draw(g, id, 0, 0, 32); const a = g.getImageData(0, 0, 32, 32).data; let n = 0; for (let i = 3; i < a.length; i += 4) if (a[i] > 40) n++; if (n < 120) bad.push(id + ':' + n); }
  return { ok: !bad.length && !ST.err, n: Object.keys(M).length, bad, err: ST.err }; }
 return { M, has, draw, blit, html, scan, audit, ST };
})();

function tcF9Time() { const p = tcF9P('time'); if (!p.dataset.built) { p.dataset.built = 1; const hm = [[6, 0], [9, 0], [12, 0], [17, 0], [19, 0], [19, 30], [22, 0], [0, 0]];
